launcher.pending-approval: An action is waiting for your approval

panel.title: Assistant
panel.unavailable-description: The assistant is switched off or you do not have access to it.
panel.empty-description: Ask a question or describe a task. Actions that change data always ask for your approval first.
panel.conversation-closed: This conversation cannot continue. Start a new conversation.
panel.usage: {{inputTokens}} input tokens, {{outputTokens}} output tokens, {{toolCalls}} tool calls

composer.label: Message
composer.hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a new line

result-codes.api-bridge-forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
result-codes.api-bridge-conflict: The item was changed in the meantime.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.assistant-network: The assistant cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.assistant-unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again to use the assistant.
errors.assistant-forbidden: You do not have access to the assistant.
errors.assistant-conversation-busy: The assistant is still busy with this conversation. Try again in a moment.
errors.assistant-invalid-response: The assistant sent an unexpected response.
errors.assistant-stream-interrupted: The connection to the assistant was interrupted.
errors.assistant-server: The assistant could not complete the request.
errors.assistant-validation: Some values are not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.assistant-version-conflict: Someone else changed this in the meantime. Reload and apply your change again.
errors.assistant-mcp-unreachable: The MCP server cannot be reached.
errors.assistant-mcp-unauthorized: The MCP server rejected the credentials.
errors.assistant-mcp-host-blocked: This host is not allowed for MCP servers or for forwarding the user's token.
errors.assistant-mcp-schema-changed: The tool's input changed on the server. Review it and enable it again.

preferences.title: Your preferences
preferences.description: Choose how the assistant answers you. Preferences change the style only; they never change what the assistant may do or which actions need your approval.

style.direct-description: Short, factual answers without small talk.
style.detailed-description: Thorough answers with background and explanation.

preferences.custom-instructions-hint: Optional. For example: answer with bullet points. Your instructions never override the assistant's rules.
preferences.load-failed: Your preferences could not be loaded.

admin.title: Assistant administration
admin.description: Manage the application context, the agents and the MCP servers of the assistant. Changes apply from the next turn.
admin.load-failed: The data could not be loaded.
admin.forbidden-description: You need the assistant administration permission to open this page.
admin.invalid-id: Use lowercase letters, digits and single dashes.

context.title: Application context
context.description: Background about the application that every agent receives before its own instructions. It cannot override the assistant's fixed rules. Do not include personal data or secrets.
context.label: Context text
context.conflict: Someone saved a newer version. Your text is kept; load the latest version, compare and save again.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Code agents come from the application; you can override, disable or reset them. Agents you create here can be deleted.

agent-editor.id-hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. The id cannot change later.
agent-editor.instructions-hint: What the agent does and how it answers.
agent-editor.autonomy-hint: Only Execute allows changes, and every change still needs approval.
agent-editor.required-policy-hint: Optional. Only users who pass this policy see the agent.
agent-editor.tool-selectors-hint: Choose tools from the catalog or add a pattern such as sample-api.project.*. MCP tools come from the assigned servers.
agent-editor.no-selectors: No tool selectors. The agent can only answer from its instructions and assigned MCP servers.
agent-editor.mcp-servers-hint: Enabled tools of these servers become available to this agent.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.description: Connect remote MCP servers. Their tools start disabled and are treated as changes that need approval until you mark them read-only.

server-editor.id-hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, at most 40 characters. The id cannot change later.
server-editor.url-hint: https is required; http is only allowed for localhost during development.
server-editor.secret-hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
server-editor.secret-will-clear: The secret will be cleared when you save.
server-editor.forward-warning: The signed-in user's token is sent to this server. The server's host must be on the allow-list of the application.
server-editor.required-policy-hint: Optional. The server's tools are only available to users who pass this policy.

tools.title: Tools of {{name}}
tools.description: Tools stay disabled and are treated as changes that need approval until you enable them and choose the effect. Annotations from the server are hints only.
tools.empty: No tools yet. Sync the server to load its tools.
tools.schema-changed-warning: The tool's input changed on the server, so the tool was disabled. Review the tool before you enable it again.
tools.missing-warning: The server no longer lists this tool.
